bullets.text: Heavy rains lashed Chennai leaving Velachery AGS Colony under knee-deep water and residents stranded, requiring the office to monitor relief and boat deployment.
Two 14-year-old schoolboys drowned in Puzhal Lake near Murugambedu, prompting the office to watch safety measures around water bodies during heavy rains.
A fire in a Poonamallee hut destroyed livestock and pets, and the office should watch for immediate relief assistance for affected families.
A University of Madras study linked Chennai's expanding built-up areas and drainage gaps to rising flood risks, requiring the office to monitor urban planning corrections.
One of the entrances to the Puzhuthivakkam MRTS station remains closed months after inauguration, forcing detours, so the office should coordinate with railways to open it.
Inflow increased into reservoirs like Puzhal and Poondi due to continuous rain, and the office must monitor water levels and safety precautions.
Commuters at the Avadi temporary bus terminus face hardships due to poor civic amenities, so the office should push CMDA to expedite the new terminus construction.
Police traced a missing eight-year-old girl from Sriperumbudur to a children's home in Kellys, and the office should ensure continued child safety and welfare checks.
Chennai Mayor Priya condemned abusive deepfake AI videos targeting her on social media without police action, so the office must monitor cyber cell interventions.
Artificial intelligence is transforming flavour development and positioning Chennai as a food innovation hub, and the office should support this technological growth.
